content:
iPadOS 27.2 will be released at the end of this month, bringing several software updates to the iPad. Below are two of the new features.

#1: Siri Context Pop-up Window

Siri AI has seen significant improvements over the older version of Siri, and I use it frequently on the iPad—usually through the CMD + Space keyboard shortcut, as Siri and Spotlight have now merged into one.

iPadOS 27.2 will introduce another convenient way to interact with Siri. This feature was previously debuted on the Mac version of macOS Golden Gate.

In iPadOS 27.2, when you select text using a trackpad or mouse, a new Siri context pop-up window will appear on the left side of the selection. When you hover the cursor over the Siri icon, the window will instantly expand, providing an "Ask Siri" text input field.

This way, you can quickly ask Siri for information related to the selected content. If you are writing text, the Siri pop-up window will also offer suggestions such as "Proofread," "Rewrite," and "How does this passage sound?" allowing you to get assistance with a single tap.

#2: Apple TV App Profiles

Whether you are an adult or a child, the iPad is an excellent video viewing device. If you share an iPad with your partner or children, the Apple TV app is about to receive a useful new feature: Profiles.

iPadOS 27.2 will introduce the profiles feature that has been available in tvOS on Apple TV 4K.

When you open the Apple TV app on the iPad, the launch screen will display a brand-new profile selection screen. You can choose the user from it, and the TV app will automatically update the watchlist, playback history, and content recommendations based on your choice.

If you are a parent, the profiles feature will take content rating restrictions into account. When a child's profile is active, they can only see movies and TV shows that match the age limits you previously set.

To learn more about the new features of iPadOS 27.2, please refer to our related coverage.
